title: SourceContent
responsibility: Connects source loading and cancellation to the shared source viewer.

inputs.name: SourceContent.files
inputs.description: Async listing restricted to the selected entity and revision.

inputs.name: SourceContent.read
inputs.description: Async reader for one recorded path at the same revision.

inputs.name: SourceContent.commit
inputs.description: Exact revision associated with the contents.

inputs.name: SourceContent.empty
inputs.description: Optional no-files explanation. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, using SourceViewer's No source files recorded at this revision. message.

outputs.name: SourceContent
outputs.description: Shows files, revision and unmodified code or the explicit empty-file status through SourceViewer. Changed files/read callbacks start a new session; unmounting cancels pending replies. Reader failures become visible error states.
